hed: Mariska Hargitay to host 78th Emmys on NBC and Peacock Sept. 14
dek: The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards air live Monday, Sept. 14 at 8 p.m. ET from Los Angeles’ Peacock Theater, with Law & Order: SVU star Mariska Hargitay hosting, NBC and the Television Academy said. The Pitt leads nominations with 25; Hacks follows with 24. Hargitay already won two Creative Arts Emmys this month for her documentary My Mom Jayne. NBC marks its 100th anniversary with a peacock-blue carpet; Peacock streams live.

cl.body: ABC News and entertainment desks frame Monday’s show as a tight race — The Pitt’s 25 nods versus Pluribus in drama, Hacks versus Widow’s Bay in comedy — with Hargitay’s hosting debut coming days after her own documentary wins.

cr.body: Network and Academy coverage stress the live coast-to-coast NBC/Peacock simulcast, NBC’s 100th-anniversary branding, and Hargitay as a franchise star hosting after Creative Arts wins — a ratings and brand play as much as an awards night.

stack_blurb: Emmys Monday 8 p.m. ET; Hargitay hosts; Pitt leads nods.
